name: Existential & Global Catastrophic Risk
description: Low-probability, civilization-scale threats and the meta-questions of how much to prioritize, slow, or surveil to prevent them.

name: AI & Machine Intelligence
description: How advanced AI is built, governed, aligned, and valued — capability trajectories, control, regulation, and machine minds.

name: Digital Society & Information
description: How networked technology reshapes speech, privacy, surveillance, data, and shared truth.

name: Climate & Energy
description: Decarbonization strategy, energy systems, and the pace, cost, and politics of the transition.

name: Bio, Health & the Human Body
description: Medicine, biotechnology, and the contested limits of intervening in human biology, reproduction, and death.

name: Economy & Work
description: How wealth, prices, markets, and labor are organized, distributed, and governed.

name: Governance & Political Order
description: How power is constituted, constrained, and contested — democracy, law, rights, and the international order.

name: Society, Culture & Identity
description: How communities, identities, demographics, and social bonds are changing and whom institutions should serve.

name: Ethics & Philosophy
description: Foundational questions of value, mind, moral status, meaning, and what we owe one another across time.

name: Food, Land & the Living World
description: How we feed ourselves and share the planet — agriculture, animals, land, water, and the stewardship of nature.
